set.body:
Journey: See. Track: console.

Outcome
A curator reads what is wrong and what to do without knowing rule names. Identifiers no longer lead the page.

Acceptance
1. Every finding kind that the demo and pilot studies produce has a title, a one-sentence explanation and a suggested fix. The rule code stays available in a details disclosure. A finding kind without text falls back to its code, and a test lists such kinds so gaps are visible.
2. Digests and UUIDs (manifest, interpretation, assessment, dataset and release identifiers) move behind one Provenance disclosure on the release and study pages. People appear by name everywhere.
3. Visible defects are fixed: the query result's participant column shows sub-sub-02 because app.js line 1626 adds a second prefix; the MRI viewer's plane selector and slider are unstyled; Add files uses unstyled inputs.

Not in scope
Comparing two releases. That part of the original D13 is parked.

Start from
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js: findings in releaseView, selectionView near line 1599.
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/nifti-viewer.js and upload.js.

Evidence
Console checks and screenshots.
set.title: SEE6: Plain-language findings; provenance behind a disclosure (was D13)
